lines.zh: 缓慢的脚步声回荡在黑暗中。
lines.en: Slow footsteps echo in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的手臂沉重地摆动着。
lines.en: Its heavy arms swing ponderously.

lines.zh: 盔甲摩擦着地面，发出嘎吱声。
lines.en: Metal armor grinds against the ground.

lines.zh: 低沉的呼吸声透露其接近。
lines.en: Low breaths give away its approach.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官蹒跚地行走。
lines.en: The dwarf commander staggers forward.

lines.zh: 它的步态笨拙而缓慢。
lines.en: Its gait is clumsy and slow.

lines.zh: 厚重的靴子在石地板上敲击。
lines.en: Heavy boots thud against the stone floor.

lines.zh: 铁甲在黑夜中反射微光。
lines.en: Iron armor glimmers faintly in the dark.

lines.zh: 它蹒跚前行，似乎拖着沉重的负担。
lines.en: It stumbles forward, burdened heavily.

lines.zh: 脚步声越来越近，令人不安。
lines.en: Footsteps draw closer, unsettlingly.

lines.zh: 我拖着战锤，一步步逼近。
lines.en: I drag my warhammer forward step by step.

lines.zh: 破靴子踩碎了地上的骨片。
lines.en: My torn boots crunch the bones on the floor.

lines.zh: 它低头看着手中的指挥权杖。
lines.en: It lowers its gaze to its command staff.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人指挥官的肩膀微微下沉。
lines.en: The dwarf commander's shoulders sag slightly.

lines.zh: 它环顾四周，寻找目标。
lines.en: It surveys its surroundings for a target.

lines.zh: 沉闷的呼吸声伴随着它的静止。
lines.en: Dull breaths accompany its stillness.

lines.zh: 它微微皱眉，似乎在思考。
lines.en: It furrows its brow, contemplating.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人指挥官紧握着权杖。
lines.en: The dwarf commander grips its staff tightly.

lines.zh: 它的目光在黑暗中闪烁。
lines.en: Its eyes flicker in the darkness.

lines.zh: 沉闷的笑声在寂静中回响。
lines.en: Dull laughter reverberates in the silence.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人指挥官环视着空荡的洞穴。
lines.en: The dwarf commander scans the empty cave.

lines.zh: 它紧闭双唇，似乎在克制自己。
lines.en: It clamps its lips, restraining itself.

lines.zh: 我把战锤横在膝上磨着。
lines.en: I lay my warhammer across my knee and whet it.

lines.zh: 盔甲缝里爬出几只潮虫。
lines.en: Woodlice crawl out of my armor's seams.

lines.zh: 我数着洞里滴水的声音。
lines.en: I count the dripping of the cave.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚着半句号令。
lines.en: Half an order grumbles in my throat.

lines.zh: 它的目光突然锁定了玩家。
lines.en: Its gaze suddenly locks on the player.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人指挥官紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: The dwarf commander stares intently at the player.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着敌意。
lines.en: Hostility flickers in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它的目光中充满警惕。
lines.en: Its gaze is filled with alertness.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人指挥官的视线在黑暗中穿梭。
lines.en: The dwarf commander's gaze weaves through the darkness.

lines.zh: 它试图从玩家身上寻找弱点。
lines.en: It tries to spot weaknesses in the player.

lines.zh: 它的目光中流露出怀疑。
lines.en: Skepticism glimmers in its gaze.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人指挥官盯紧了玩家。
lines.en: The dwarf commander fixes on the player.

lines.zh: 它的目光在黑暗中搜寻着玩家。
lines.en: Its gaze searches for the player in the darkness.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人指挥官的目光中带着威胁。
lines.en: Threat looms in its gaze.

lines.zh: 我抬起缺角的头盔看你。
lines.en: I lift my chipped helm to look at you.

lines.zh: 独眼在你身上来回打量。
lines.en: My one eye measures you up and down.

lines.zh: 我把你当成了逃兵。
lines.en: I take you for a deserter.

lines.zh: 目光从靴子爬到你的刀。
lines.en: My gaze climbs from your boots to your blade.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，记住了你的脸。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes and memorize your face.

lines.zh: 头盔下的呼吸变粗了。
lines.en: My breathing thickens under the helm.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看有无兵器。
lines.en: I watch your hands for a weapon.

lines.zh: 眼睛在暗处泛出油光。
lines.en: My eyes glisten greasily in the dark.

lines.zh: 铁甲碎裂了！
lines.en: My armor cracks!

lines.zh: 腿动不了了...
lines.en: Can't move my legs...

lines.zh: 感觉很痛...
lines.en: It hurts...

lines.zh: 盾牌被击穿了！
lines.en: My shield is pierced!

lines.zh: 骨头断了！
lines.en: Broken bones!

lines.zh: 受伤了，需要治疗...
lines.en: Injured, need healing...

lines.zh: 呼吸困难...
lines.en: Trouble breathing...

lines.zh: 被石头砸了...
lines.en: Hit by a rock...

lines.zh: 矮人的盔甲挡不住这一刀。
lines.en: Dwarven armor didn't stop that blade.

lines.zh: 矮人的短腿撑不住这一下。
lines.en: A dwarf's short legs can't take another blow.

lines.zh: 它歪歪扭扭地盯着你，眼中闪烁着饥饿的光芒。
lines.en: It staggers at you, eyes glowing with hunger.

lines.zh: 它粗糙的手掌中捧着一颗发光的蛋，似乎在诱惑你。
lines.en: Its rough hand holds a glowing egg, tempting you.

lines.zh: 它的双臂挥舞着，似乎在寻找食物。
lines.en: Its arms flail, searching for food.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的咕噜声，似乎在呼唤同类。
lines.en: It grumbles lowly, calling for its kind.

lines.zh: 它笨拙地接近你，手中的剑摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: It clumsily approaches you, sword wobbling in hand.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着你，似乎在评估你的价值。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on you, assessing your worth.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地挪动着，似乎在寻找食物的踪迹。
lines.en: It moves slowly, following the scent of food.

lines.zh: 它发出沙哑的叫声，似乎在警告你。
lines.en: It rasps, warning you away.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着狡黠的光芒，似乎在计划着什么。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam slyly, planning something.

lines.zh: 它笨拙地举起手中的蛋，似乎在尝试孵化。
lines.en: It clumsily raises the egg, attempting to hatch it.

lines.zh: 你的剑刃与它的笨拙身躯碰撞，发出沉重的声音。
lines.en: Your blade clatters against its clumsy form.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞上了你的盾牌，发出钝响。
lines.en: Its body thuds against your shield.

lines.zh: 它撞向岩石，发出沉闷的响声。
lines.en: It crashes into the rock, making a dull sound.

lines.zh: 你一剑砍向它，它歪歪扭扭地倒下。
lines.en: You stab it, and it falls awkwardly.

lines.zh: 它的头撞在墙上，发出闷响。
lines.en: Its head smashes into the wall, making a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞上你的斧头，溅起一串火星。
lines.en: Its body collides with your axe, splattering sparks.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，你迅速避开。
lines.en: It crashes into you, and you dodge quickly.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌挡住了它的撞击，发出金属声。
lines.en: Your shield blocks its collision, ringing with metal.

lines.zh: 你用盾牌抵挡它的撞击，溅起碎片。
lines.en: You parry its collision, sending shards flying.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞在你的剑刃上，发出金属碰撞声。
lines.en: Its body crashes into your blade, making a metallic clashing sound.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，似乎在寻找合适的伴侣。
lines.en: It stares at you, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它的叫声中带着求偶的意味。
lines.en: Its call hints at mating.

lines.zh: 它笨拙地靠近你，似乎在邀请你。
lines.en: It clumsily approaches you, inviting you.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着求偶的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with mating desire.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的咕噜声，似乎在寻求你的注意。
lines.en: It grumbles lowly, seeking your attention.

lines.zh: 它笨拙地绕着你转圈，似乎在展示自己。
lines.en: It clumsily circles you, showing off.

lines.zh: 它用粗糙的手掌轻触你，似乎在求偶。
lines.en: It touches you with its rough hand, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它的叫声中带着一丝焦急。
lines.en: Its call carries a hint of urgency.

lines.zh: 它笨拙地跳起来，似乎在进行求偶的舞蹈。
lines.en: It clumsily leaps, performing a mating dance.

lines.zh: 它的叫声中充满了求偶的渴望。
lines.en: Its call is filled with mating desire.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官低沉吼叫，发出沉重的声响。
lines.en: The dwarf commander growls, producing a heavy sound.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官发出嘶嘶声，摸索着前进。
lines.en: The dwarf commander hisses, feeling its way forward.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官盯着你，发出沉闷的低吼。
lines.en: The dwarf commander stares at you, issuing a deep growl.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官挥舞着双手，仿佛在寻找什么。
lines.en: The dwarf commander waves its hands, as if searching for something.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官发出咔嚓声，似乎在咀嚼着什么。
lines.en: The dwarf commander makes a cracking sound, as if chewing something.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官低声咕哝，似乎在准备战斗。
lines.en: The dwarf commander mutters softly, preparing for battle.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的脚掌在石地上摩擦，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s feet scrape against the stone, producing a rustling sound.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官发出咔哒声，可能在修理武器。
lines.en: The dwarf commander makes a clicking sound, possibly fixing its weapon.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的呼吸声沉重而响亮。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s breath is heavy and loud.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官低声咒骂，似乎在不满。
lines.en: The dwarf commander mutters under its breath, clearly unhappy.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官盯着你，眼中闪烁着贪婪的光芒。
lines.en: The dwarf commander stares at you, with greedy eyes.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的脸上露出狡猾的微笑。
lines.en: A sly smile appears on the dwarf commander’s face.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官发出嘶嘶声，似乎在计算下一步。
lines.en: The dwarf commander hisses, calculating its next move.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官盯着你，眼中充满威胁。
lines.en: The dwarf commander stares at you, with threatening eyes.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官盯着你，眼中掠过一丝兴奋。
lines.en: Excitement flits across the dwarf commander’s eyes as it stares at you.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官盯着你，似乎在制定计划。
lines.en: The dwarf commander stares at you, planning its strategy.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的目光紧锁在你身上。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s gaze is fixed on you.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的脸上露出一丝满意的微笑。
lines.en: A satisfied smile appears on the dwarf commander’s face.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官盯着你，眼中满是敌意。
lines.en: The dwarf commander stares at you with malice in its eyes.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官盯着你，眼中透露出狡猾。
lines.en: The dwarf commander stares at you, with cunning in its eyes.

lines.zh: 集合吧，你就一个人。
lines.en: Fall in. You are the whole squad.

lines.zh: 我把你记进了阵亡名册。
lines.en: I have entered you in the casualty list.

lines.zh: 号令一下，你就跑不掉。
lines.en: At my word, you will not get away.

lines.zh: 战锤抬起，指向你的胸口。
lines.en: My hammer rises, pointed at your chest.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，别装死。
lines.en: I see you. Do not play dead.

lines.zh: 目标确认，是个软骨头。
lines.en: Target confirmed: a soft one.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官伸出一只手，似乎要抓住你。
lines.en: The dwarf commander extends a hand, as if to grab you.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的手指向你指去，发出咔嚓声。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s fingers point at you, making a clicking sound.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的手指在空中画出你的轮廓。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s fingers trace your outline in the air.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的手指在你身上游移，寻找弱点。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s fingers roam over you, searching for weaknesses.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的指节在你的轮廓上轻轻敲打。
lines.en: The dwarf commander taps your outline with its knuckles gently.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的手指在你身上寻找目标。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s fingers search for targets on you.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的手指在空中摆出攻击姿势。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s fingers form an attacking pose in the air.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的手指在你身上轻轻触碰。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s fingers lightly touch you.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的手指在你身上摸索。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s fingers feel you.

lines.zh: 矮人指挥官的手指在你身上划过。
lines.en: The dwarf commander’s fingers stroke you.

lines.zh: 我把重心压到前脚上。
lines.en: I shift my weight onto my front foot.

lines.zh: 战锤在头顶转了一圈。
lines.en: My warhammer circles once overhead.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，给自己壮胆。
lines.en: I bellow once to steady my nerve.

lines.zh: 脚掌在湿石上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I scuff my soles on the wet stone.

lines.zh: 我算好你后退的那一步。
lines.en: I have counted the step you will retreat.

lines.zh: 盔甲里的我笑出了声。
lines.en: Inside my armor, I laugh out loud.

lines.zh: 锤柄被我攥得吱吱响。
lines.en: The haft creaks in my grip.

lines.zh: 我不急，慢慢收拾你。
lines.en: No hurry. I will take you apart slowly.

lines.zh: 挥舞着破旧的斧头逼近！
lines.en: Charges with an old axe!

lines.zh: 笨拙中带着一丝狡猾！
lines.en: Clumsy, yet cunning!

lines.zh: 挥剑的同时踉跄前行！
lines.en: Stumbles forward with a swing!

lines.zh: 粗陋的盔甲发出吱吱声！
lines.en: Rusty armor creaks!

lines.zh: 笨拙的动作中透露着杀意！
lines.en: Clumsy movements, deadly intent!

lines.zh: 挥舞的短剑仿佛无头苍蝇！
lines.en: Sword swings like a headless fly!

lines.zh: 粗大的手掌握着沉重的锤子！
lines.en: Huge hands clutch a heavy hammer!

lines.zh: 笨拙地挥舞着火炬攻击！
lines.en: Holds torch and stumbles!

lines.zh: 试图用锤子击碎你的头盔！
lines.en: Swings hammer at your helmet!

lines.zh: 挥剑时差点摔倒在地！
lines.en: Falls as he swings his sword!

lines.zh: 战锤横砸你的膝盖！
lines.en: My hammer smashes across your knees!

lines.zh: 我用肩甲撞你的胸口！
lines.en: I drive my pauldron into your chest!

lines.zh: 锤头擦着你的耳朵过去！
lines.en: The hammerhead grazes past your ear!

lines.zh: 我一脚踹在你的肚子上！
lines.en: I plant a boot in your gut!

lines.zh: 铁手套抓住你的领子！
lines.en: My gauntlet grabs your collar!

lines.zh: 我抡圆了砸你的后背！
lines.en: I swing a full arc into your back!

lines.zh: 从破旧的石堆中跃出！
lines.en: Springs from rubble!

lines.zh: 在石洞中悄然现身！
lines.en: Appears in a stone cavern!

lines.zh: 从黑暗的裂缝中爬出！
lines.en: Crawls from a crack!

lines.zh: 从岩壁的阴影中走出！
lines.en: Walks from shadows!

lines.zh: 在洞穴深处静静等待！
lines.en: Lurks in the cave!

lines.zh: 从古老隧道的出口现身！
lines.en: Appears from an old tunnel!

lines.zh: 在废墟中悄然潜行！
lines.en: Crawls in ruins!

lines.zh: 在荒废的矿井中等待！
lines.en: Waits in an abandoned mine!

lines.zh: 从破碎的岩壁中跳出！
lines.en: Jumps from broken rock!

lines.zh: 在黑暗的地下通道现身！
lines.en: Appears in a dark tunnel!

lines.zh: 矿井支架塌了，我走出来。
lines.en: The mine props collapse and I walk out.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎砖爬出废墟。
lines.en: I climb out of the rubble over broken bricks.

lines.zh: 号角一响，我从洞里出来。
lines.en: A horn sounds and I come out of the hole.

lines.zh: 火把照亮了我歪斜的影子。
lines.en: A torch lights my crooked shadow.

lines.zh: 我从塌方的尽头现身。
lines.en: I appear at the end of the cave-in.

lines.zh: 地下的鼓声把我叫醒了。
lines.en: The drums below have woken me.

lines.zh: 我扛着战锤走出烟尘。
lines.en: I shoulder my hammer and walk out of the dust.

lines.zh: 洞口的碎石还在往下掉。
lines.en: Gravel is still falling at the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 指挥官的头盔烧得滚烫。
lines.en: My commander's helm is burning hot.

lines.zh: 掉进了深渊...
lines.en: Fell into the void...

lines.zh: 铁甲碎裂了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My armor cracks! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 腿动不了了...，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Can't move my legs — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肩甲缝里，拔不出。
lines.en: The arrow is wedged in my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击击中了我...
lines.en: Hit by magic...

lines.zh: 感觉很痛...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: It hurts — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷火顺着铁盔往下淌。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the inside of my helm.

lines.zh: 坠入虚无深渊...
lines.en: Dropped into the void...
